research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Hubble Network is researching methods for connecting Bluetooth-enabled devices via satellite networks, focusing on location determination using angle-of-arrival and time-of-flight, communication with multiple satellite networks, and position determination using antenna arrays. Their work includes multi spoke beamforming for low power wide area satellite and terrestrial communication, enabling endpoint devices to communicate and be located even without cellular reception.

overview_description.description: Hubble Network offers a platform that enables device tracking and data transmission using Bluetooth chips, without requiring additional infrastructure or custom hardware. It delivers a terrestrial network of tens of millions of access points that cover indoor, urban, and in-transit environments, with plans to expand via satellite to reach remote locations. It provides visibility into asset location and condition for a variety of use cases, including cold chain monitoring, rental equipment recovery, warehouse and yard operations, secure item movement, and intermodal logistics. Integration is supported via APIs and SDKs, and data is encrypted end-to-end using AES. The system works with existing off-the-shelf Bluetooth chips, avoiding hardware lock-in.

about_short_description.short_description: Hubble Network is a developer of a satellite-powered Bluetooth network that enables devices to connect regardless of cellular reception.

product.name: Hubble Terrestrial Network
product.description: A Bluetooth Low Energy connectivity network that collects data from compatible devices through more than 100 million scanning gateways and delivers it to customer systems.

product.name: Hubble Device SDK
product.description: A software development kit for integrating Hubble connectivity into devices that use compatible Bluetooth Low Energy chips or microcontrollers.

product.name: Hubble Platform Cloud API
product.description: A RESTful cloud API for registering and managing devices, retrieving Bluetooth packet data, configuring webhooks, and accessing organization and platform information.

product.name: Hubble Sandbox
product.description: A free development environment for testing Hubble-connected devices through the Hubble Connect mobile app, with API, SDK, documentation, and reference application access.

product.name: Hubble Live
product.description: A production connectivity service that provides access to Hubble’s terrestrial Bluetooth network for deployed devices and operational IoT fleets.

product.name: Hubble Satellite Network
product.description: A planned low Earth orbit satellite connectivity service intended to receive Bluetooth data from compatible devices in remote and off-grid locations.
